integration_gaps.affected: World/character events, boss completion, room shrine activation, NPC reward claims and Lava Pump destruction.
integration_gaps.required_work: Bind typed source predicates to accepted Game quest/event state when runtime quest definitions exist; client quest-line source_id is only a provenance locator.

notes: All 24 Powerful unlock definitions are populated from quest-specific Global reference pages. The summary Imbuements page omits several post-boss reward actions; these are included here.
A Premium or quest requirement applies to shrine crafting/scroll inscription, not wearing an already imbued item or applying a valid scroll.

No entire quest completion is required for a Forgotten Knowledge branch unlock: its boss defeat plus room shrine use suffices. All previous portals are access prerequisites for the final Lore Keeper boss; they are not duplicated as separate imprint gates.
The world temple construction consists of an earlier collective quest event. The character contributes five Heavy Old Tomes once; world contribution quantities are not charged per imbue.
These records are authoring facts, not a runtime quest implementation or an assertion that source client quest-line IDs are canonical Game quest identities.

The accepted source manifest identifies client version 15.30 but contains no dated snapshot field; this packet does not infer a client capture date from version or file metadata. External access sources were retrieved on captured_on, rather than archived at the client snapshot date.
No Intricate or Powerful completed-scroll loot is asserted without a named drop source. Null acquisition values mean unknown, not impossible.
status_scope: Source access and crafting predicate definitions; scroll acquisition has separate item-specific evidence statuses.
